glav_novel_view.description: Held-out novel-view synthesis under global and local appearance variation (paper Table 1 protocol): each held-out capture's appearance may be fitted on its left half only; quality is measured on its right half. Scored on the 6 hidden test scenes x 6 held-out captures.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) over held-out right halves.

ssim.description: Mean SSIM (11x11 Gaussian window) over held-out right halves.

lpips.description: Mean LPIPS (v0.1, AlexNet) over held-out right halves.

glav_novel_view._scale_note: Result values are the paper's GLAV Table 1 numbers (seven real 1080p captures, 30k iterations). This gym uses procedurally generated, ray-traced 96x128 scenes with 30 training and 6 held-out captures each and 6k iterations, so absolute values are not targets; the reference run in scoring/scores_test.json is what attempts are ranked against.

glav_average_appearance.description: Quality of the scene rendered without any per-capture appearance state (paper Table 4 protocol: colour correction before metrics to evaluate the average appearance). The appearance-free render of each held-out camera is colour-corrected (mip-NeRF 360 quadratic warp) to that camera's average appearance over the training captures and scored on the right half (the left half is a visible input). It doubles as the decoupling constraint: a method more than 1 dB below the frozen vanilla 3DGS render here fails the run.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) of colour-corrected appearance-free renders against the average-appearance target.

ssim.description: Mean SSIM of colour-corrected appearance-free renders.

lpips.description: Mean LPIPS (v0.1, AlexNet) of colour-corrected appearance-free renders.

glav_average_appearance._scale_note: Result values are the paper's Table 4 ablation numbers on GLAV (full model, xyz -> uv + depth, w/o L_ID). The paper colour-corrects to each observed test image; this gym colour-corrects to the camera's average appearance over the training captures (an evaluator-owned target a method cannot copy from its own adapted output). Vanilla 3DGS is not reported in Table 4.
